fiction: A carved gourd of amber sap drawn from a Hist tree. Refilled by resting at a Hist-stump (the rest-site analogue).

charges.increase: +1 per Hist Seed consumed at a rest site (10 seeds exist in the world)
charges.refill_by_gold_forbidden_because: ARBITRATION S15 — gold is the only currency and it buys nothing that shortcuts a fight

level.raised_at: a rest site, with Sap Amber

heal.applied_as: a RAMP over 62 f@60, not a lump

animation.interrupted_43_to_104: stagger; charge lost, HP restored so far is kept
animation.heal_secure_note: the derived number that makes healing computable — the player must be untouchable for 104 f from the press to bank the full heal. Compare against RI-AI03's P_safe; an enemy move offering P_safe >= 120 f@60 affords a full heal with 16 frames of slack.

declared_blend.statement: RI-CMB08's flask mixes DS1 charge counts (5 at start) with DS3 upgrade rules (+0..+10 by consumable shards). Both are defensible; the blend is declared here rather than presented as one game's design.

forbidden: buying flask charges or any in-combat healing with gold (S15)
flask charges as a difficulty setting
enemies healing without the same commitment — an enemy that heals must use a >= 104 f@60 committed, interruptible animation and must lose the heal when interrupted
any ring, buff or stat that reduces the 130 f@60 animation (frame counts are invariant, RI-CMB02 §D.7)
passive HP regeneration of any kind
